# Intpot

Intpot is a Python framework for defining typed tools once and serving them through CLI, API, and MCP interfaces, or converting existing Typer, FastAPI, and FastMCP apps.

## Pages
- [Overview](https://intpot.modepot.io/): product introduction and interface model.
- [Quick start](https://intpot.modepot.io/quickstart/): install and run an Intpot app.
- [Capabilities and boundaries](https://intpot.modepot.io/capabilities/): current workflows, compatibility, and conversion limits.

## Project resources
- [GitHub](https://github.com/tugrulguner/intpot)
- [ModePot](https://modepot.io/)

The site documents behavior present in the Intpot source; generated code should be reviewed and tested in its target framework.
